items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.eks_subnet1)
items.issue: Public IPs automatically assigned on launch
items.remediation: Change the subnet attribute map_public_ip_on_launch = false and use private subnets for EKS nodes and cluster networking.

items.issue: Public IPs automatically assigned on launch

items.known: CKV_AWS_39 Ensure Amazon EKS public endpoint disabled (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS public API endpoint not explicitly disabled
items.remediation: In the vpc_config block, add endpoint_public_access = false to restrict API server access to the private endpoint only.
